paite: Zawlnei Habakkuk thumna, Sigionoth toh kituak a bawl
heading: Habakkuk Thumna
english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

paite: Aw TOUPA, na tanchin agen uh ka za a, ka lau hi. Aw TOUPA, kumte lak ah nasep hihhalh in, kumte lak ah kitheisak in; thangpaihna zahngaihna theigige in.
english: Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

paite: eman a kipan in Pathian ahong pai a, Paran tang a kipan in Mi Siangthou, Selah Athupina in vante atuam a, amah phatna in leitung adim hi.
english: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

paite: Amah thupina vak bang ahi a; akhut a pan nizung ahong suakkhia hi; athilhihtheihna huai ah akhuh hi.
english: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

paite: Ama ah hipi apai a, akhepekte ah suangkuangthei kuang apaikheta hi.
english: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

paite: Adingh a, lei alingsak a; amu a, namte ahawlzak hi; tangtawn tangte hihdalh in a-omta ua, tangtawn mualte akun ua, apaina nidang a bang ahi.
english: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

paite: Kushan puaninte gimthuak in ka mu a; Midian gam mite alinggawp uhi.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

paite: Luite tung a TOUPA lungkim lou ahi diam aw? Luite tung a na hehna om hia ahihkeileh tuipi tung a na thangpaihna, na sakolte tung a na tuanna leh hotdamna na kangtalaite tung a na tuanna?
english: Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

paite: Na thalpeu avuak petmah a bawl ahi; namte kiang ah kichiamnate thutak ahi uh, Selah Luite'n lei akhangkhamsak hi.
english: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

paite: Tangte'n nang ahon mu ua, alau uh; tui khang in akheng a, tui thuk in a-aw asuah a, tungsang ah khutte aliktou hi.
english: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

paite: A-omna uah ni leh kha adingh kinken ua; apai bang un na thalte vak ah, na teipi te zolzol in avak uhi.
english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

paite: Heh in gam na palsuak petmah a, thangpai in namte na chil hi.
english: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

paite: Na mipite hondam ding in na kuankhia a, na thaunilh hotdamna ding in; giloute inn a kipan lutang na hihliam a; ngawng chiang pha hial in suangphum na hihse vek. Selah
english: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

paite: Agalhatte lutang amah chiangte ngei in na sun a; kei hon dalhsak ding in pingpei bang in ahong pai uhi; nuam asakna uh gentheite aguk a ne khin ding in ahi.
english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

paite: Na sakolte in tuipi leh tui hatte sunvumte na chil hi.
english: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

paite: Ka za a, ka gilpi akising a, ka kam a awte aling pupulh a; ka guhte ah muatna ahong lut a, ka mun ah ka linggawp hi; buai ni a amah sim dia hong kuan mite dou ding a ahong paitouh chiang a ka linlouhna ding in, dai dide in ka ngak ding hi.
english: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

paite: Theipi kung pak pha lou in, grep guite ah agah om lou in; olive sepgimna vuaksuak in, loute'n nek ding piangsak lou in; huang a pan ganhonte satkhiak a om in, huangsung ah ganta omta kei mahleh;
english: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,

paite: huchipi in leng TOUPA ah ka kipak ding a, ka hotdamna Pathian ah ka nuam ding hi.
english: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

paite: Jehovah, TOUPA, ka hatna ahi, ka khepekte zukpi khe bang in abawl a, ka mun sangte ah ahon vaksak ding hi. Lapu lian a ding, tumging guineite a sak ding.
english: Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
